Hmm, but they're split into Range 1 and Range 2, with different vmin values. This is interesting. Range 1: Emax 220/1760/4000/6000 kg with vmin per class. Range 2: Emax 550/1100 kg with different vmin.

Actually in R60 certs, "Range 1" and "Range 2" refer to multiple ranges (multiple ranges of a load cell: Dm = Emax2/Emax1 ratio). Hmm, but here Emax differs per range, meaning these are multi-range load cells? Actually in load cell certificates, "Range 1 / Range 2" typically denotes different capacity models grouped. Hmm.

Actually, for R60, a load cell may have "range" definitions where Range 1 covers certain Emax values and Range 2 covers others. E.g., HLCA series might have capacities 220 kg, 550 kg, 1.1 t, 1.76 t, 4 t, 6 t. Range 1 lists 220/1760/4000/6000 and Range 2 lists 550/1100. The vmin differs: Range 1: vmin 0.0285% for D1 and 0.0100% for C3/C4/C6; Range 2: 0.0285% for D1 and 0.0090% for C3/C4/C6.
